scripts.dev:reset-local-state: rm -rf .wrangler/state && echo 'Local Wrangler state cleared. Stop any running API (Ctrl+C on npm run dev), then start again with: npm run dev'
scripts.dev:fresh: sh -c 'lsof -ti :8787 2>/dev/null | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf .wrangler/state; exec wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.toml --port 8787'
